newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Labour and Alliance talks completed.
newsitem.headline: NZ Labour and Alliance talks completed.

text.p: Members of the Labour and the Alliance parties had an informal meeting early on Thursday, an Alliance spokesperson said.
Reuters had earlier been told the meeting would be held later on Thursday.
"It was to progress issues connected with when the confidence vote would apply and related issues of parliamentary process," the spokesperson said.
He declined to say how close the parties were to agreement.
The next meeting will be on Monday.
